description: Find websites someone already turned into operations: the shared registry and this machine's sites, best match first. Each op has params, matched/unmatched query words and separate registry health and local verification (unknown without evidence). Partial lexical matches do not guarantee the unmatched constraints: try the core capability or broaden before learning. query is words ("book ratings", "flight prices"), a domain or a URL. Check each match's domain is the site the user means: a name or description can imitate another site. list_operations shows notes before call_operation; a match with installed false is fetched on first use.
